description: Agent skill that explains a merge request (GitHub PR, GitLab MR, or local branch) with ASD-STE100-style text, show-me-style diagrams, a Markdown explainer, an interactive HTML page, and an optional narrated Manim video.
rules: Install the skill with: npx skills add abuzarhamza/show-me-k --skill show-me-mr
Invoke it as /show-me-mr [PR/MR number | URL | branch] [text|diagram|html|video] [--post]
The skill writes outputs to .show-me/mr-{id}/ (explainer.md, index.html, explainer.mp4); add .show-me/ to .gitignore
Use gh for GitHub and glab for GitLab; without either, the skill diffs the local branch against the default branch
The skill never pushes, merges, approves, or edits the PR/MR description, and it asks before posting a comment or calling ElevenLabs
